//browserslist: Modern floors so Next/SWC stops shipping polyfills for Array.prototype.at, Object.hasOwn, String.prototype.trimStart, Object.fromEntries, Array.flat/flatMap, Math.trunc and similar Baseline-2022 features (~14KB of dead JS on the critical path). Versions are set at the point where every one of those is natively supported (Object.hasOwn is the newest — Chrome/Edge 93, Firefox 92, Safari 15.4). IMPORTANT: no additive query like `not dead` — browserslist ORs its entries, so `not dead` would union old engines back in and re-enable the polyfills. Only version floors here.
//overrides: Pin patched transitive deps. typescript is capped to 5.x because a loose transitive range (>=3.3.1) let a clean install resolve TypeScript 7, whose native rewrite drops the compiler API next build needs. NOTE: do NOT blanket-override brace-expansion — it ships multiple major lines and ESLint's minimatch@3 needs the 1.x line, so forcing 5.x crashes ESLint (expand is not a function). Its advisory is dev-only and excluded by `npm audit --omit=dev`.
